task.title: Cancel tasks through an explicit workflow-phase turn
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/761 with a phase-assisted cancellation that preserves provider output as Attempt evidence and the exact caller-owned cancellation reason.
acceptance_criteria: Validate task association, fresh Attempt identity, writable session, and phase skills before provider effects.
Persist a valid assistant response and Attempt atomically before cancellation.
Apply the exact caller cancellation reason without deriving it from provider content.
Preserve ordered provider-failure and terminal-race prefixes without changing workflow lifecycle.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused suite failed with missing-method errors because cancel_workflow_phase_task_turn did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added selected-skill, Attempt, exact-reason, preflight, provider-failure, and terminal-race tests.

attempts.diagnostic: The shared phase-task preflight and existing cancellation semantics supplied the required narrow composition points.
attempts.patch: Added one phase-assisted cancellation method that retains TaskCancellation, commits assistant/Attempt evidence, then applies the caller reason.

attempts.summary: Prevented rate-limited review from racing merge.
attempts.diagnostic: The exact head passed Rust CI while CodeRabbit reported a cooldown and no substantive review.
attempts.patch: Preserved the head with auto-merge disarmed and deliberately resumed review after cooldown and cross-repository budget inspection.

outcome.summary: A caller-selected phase can produce final Attempt evidence before explicit task cancellation, but the cancellation reason and all workflow lifecycle decisions remain caller-owned.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime --locked

lessons: Cancellation reason is caller-owned terminal intent, not a model-generated conclusion.
Symmetric terminal APIs should reuse mechanics without blurring distinct semantic types.
Provider output remains Attempt evidence even when immediately followed by a terminal decision.
Review cooldowns must leave merge automation disarmed.
